target.title: fix(skills): reject skill downloads exceeding 100 MB
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`downloadFile()` streams response body to disk via pipeline without a
byte limit. A hostile server can send unbounded data, filling the disk.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added `SKILL_DOWNLOAD_MAX_BYTES` (100 MB) and a post-download file size
check. If the temp file exceeds the limit, it is rejected with a clear
error before the file is consumed by downstream extraction.

## User Impact

**Before:** No size limit — unbounded disk usage
**After:** Downloads over 100 MB rejected with error message

## Evidence

Branch: `fix/install-download-maxbytes` | Base: `upstream/main` | Node: v22.19.0 Linux x64

### Regression tests

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/skills/lifecycle/install-download.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  7 passed (7)
```

### Live proof: node --import tsx

Import OK — production module loads, SKILL_DOWNLOAD_MAX_BYTES = 100 MB

### Checks

- oxlint — passed
- git diff --check — passed

### Diff

